transport: Authenticated localhost JSON: POST {method, params}; or supervisor call METHOD --params JSON

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Read current joints and save a timestamped camera image. The LLM must inspect image_path before motion.

tools.name: load_model
tools.description: Load frozen SmolVLA weights and audit exact normalization feature bindings; starts an asynchronous job without actuation.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Generate and save a real VLA action chunk without execution. Unbound normalization outputs have no verified robot units.

tools.name: start_task
tools.description: Start one bounded job. vla requires valid normalization. wrist_nod is an explicitly deterministic skill, restricted to wrist_flex and at most 3 degrees amplitude. Execution completion does not establish task success; inspect status and image afterward.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read asynchronous job, recording and watchdog status; renew a 60 second supervision lease within the fixed session deadline.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Cancel the current job, release owned torque and verify all motor torque-off readbacks.

tools.name: annotate
tools.description: Save the external LLM's concise observations, decision rationale, success assessment and uncertainty with evidence references.

tools.name: shutdown
tools.description: Stop motion, close the recording, camera and serial port, and finalize the report.
